seo.title: Sarmayacar | Early-stage venture capital in Pakistan
seo.description: Sarmayacar is an early-stage venture capital firm in Lahore and Karachi backing daring founders building technology companies in Pakistan.

content.label: What we believe
content.text: Pakistan will build enduring global companies. We back the founders defining that future—with conviction, discipline, and permanence.

content.label: Our approach
content.headline: Adding value beyond capital.
content.intro: Our team comes from banking, private equity and company building. We back founders from the first idea to the later rounds, and we stay for the long term.

items.title: International practice, local ground
items.text: We bring the standards of international venture investing to Pakistan and apply them through a team on the ground that knows the culture, the history and how business is done here. Both matter. Neither is enough alone.

items.title: Conviction-led decisions
items.text: We decide together, on evidence, and we decide clearly. When we back a founder, we put our judgment on the line and follow through on what we commit. Founders and investors get the same transparency from us.

items.title: First cheque to follow-on
items.text: Our Operator Angels back pre-revenue ideas with capital and mentorship from founders who have built companies themselves. Our main fund writes larger cheques as companies grow, and we work with founders on follow-on funding.

items.title: Here for good
items.text: We build long-term partnerships, not transactions. We help founders navigate the local market and make strategic decisions. We care about our impact on the community, value diverse teams and share what we learn.

items.label: First fund closed
items.note: Closed May 2021. IFC joined the fund in 2019.

items.label: Incorporated as a VC fund
items.note: Grown from our angel syndicate. First close August 2018.

content.headline: Sector agnostic. Pakistan focused.
content.subheadline: From fintech, healthtech and logistics to agritech, edtech and gaming, we back technology companies built for Pakistan.

content.headline: Build with us.
content.body: Whether you have an idea that needs mentorship or a company ready for a larger cheque, we want to hear from you. Tell us what you are building.

seo.description: The companies Sarmayacar has backed through its Ventures fund and Operator Angel program.

content.headline: The companies we back
content.subheadline: Fifteen ventures and ten Operator Angel companies, across fintech, logistics, health, agriculture, entertainment and more.

content.headline: Our portfolio
content.ventures_intro: Our main fund backs technology businesses in Pakistan with large markets and the ambition to lead them, and writes larger cheques as companies grow.
content.angels_intro: Since 2021, our Operator Angel program has backed ideas at the earliest stage. Founders from our own portfolio invest alongside us and work with the teams directly, so capital comes with the advice of people who have built companies here.

content.headline: Bankers, investors and company builders
content.subheadline: Our General Partners bring experience from banking, private equity and building companies. A dedicated team runs deals, supports the portfolio and keeps the fund running.

content.intro: Every founder we back works with this team, from the first conversation to the follow-on round.
content.join_text: We're always on the lookout for talented individuals. Email us at

content.headline: In the news
content.subheadline: Press coverage, our newsletter and the events where we meet founders.

seo.description: Sarmayacar started as an angel syndicate in 2016 and domiciled its first fund in 2018.

content.body:
Sarmayacar began as an angel syndicate in 2016. Pakistan had little professionally managed venture capital, so in 2018 we set up our first fund. Founders gain capital that comes with real support, and investors gain a risk-managed way to back Pakistan's startups.

Since then our General Partners have grown the team, opened two offices and built a wide network across the region and its ecosystem.

items.title: Trusted Partner
items.description: Trust is the base of everything we do. We are open with founders and investors alike, and we follow through on what we commit to.

items.title: Conviction-led
items.description: We decide together, on evidence, and we stand by our decisions. We are willing to put our judgment on the line.

items.title: Beyond Capital Returns
items.description: Our purpose shapes how we invest. We care about our impact on the wider community and share what we learn.

items.title: Here for Good
items.description: We build long-term partnerships. We value diversity in our community and see it as part of what Sarmayacar leaves behind.

content.headline: Our team
content.body: Our General Partners bring experience from banking, private equity and building companies, supported by a team that runs deals and works with the portfolio.

seo.description: Founders building in Pakistan: tell Sarmayacar about your company.

content.headline: Building in Pakistan? Let's talk.
content.body:
Our funds are sector agnostic and focused on Pakistan. Alongside capital, our team helps you navigate the local market, make strategic decisions and raise follow-on funding.

Tell us about your company and we will be in touch.

content.headline: Our team
content.body: Our General Partners bring experience from banking, private equity and building companies, supported by a team that runs deals and works with the portfolio.
